phrases.phrase: If I skip breakfast, I feel hungry before lunch.
phrases.translation: Якщо я пропускаю сніданок, то відчуваю голод ще до обіду.

phrases.phrase: If a required field is empty, the form shows an error.
phrases.translation: Якщо обов’язкове поле порожнє, форма показує помилку.

phrases.phrase: If I work late, I usually take a break before dinner.
phrases.translation: Якщо я працюю допізна, то зазвичай роблю перерву перед вечерею.

phrases.phrase: If I finish work early, I'll go for a walk.
phrases.translation: Якщо я закінчу роботу раніше, то піду на прогулянку.

phrases.phrase: If you send me the details, I'll take a look.
phrases.translation: Якщо ви надішлете мені подробиці, я їх перегляну.

phrases.phrase: If the tests pass, we'll deploy the update.
phrases.translation: Якщо тести пройдуть успішно, ми розгорнемо оновлення.

phrases.phrase: If I had more free time, I'd practice English every day.
phrases.translation: Якби в мене було більше вільного часу, я практикував би англійську щодня.

phrases.phrase: If I were in your position, I'd ask for more information.
phrases.translation: Якби я був на вашому місці, то попросив би більше інформації.

phrases.phrase: If we had a larger budget, we'd test both options.
phrases.translation: Якби в нас був більший бюджет, ми протестували б обидва варіанти.

phrases.phrase: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
phrases.translation: Якби ми виїхали раніше, то встигли б на потяг.

phrases.phrase: If I had known about the meeting, I would have joined it.
phrases.translation: Якби я знав про зустріч, то долучився б до неї.

phrases.phrase: If we had tested that case, we would have found the bug before release.
phrases.translation: Якби ми протестували цей сценарій, то знайшли б помилку до релізу.

phrases.phrase: If I had gone to bed earlier, I wouldn't be so tired now.
phrases.translation: Якби я ліг спати раніше, то зараз не був би таким втомленим.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — Past condition, present result

phrases.phrase: If we had documented the decision, we'd understand it better now.
phrases.translation: Якби ми задокументували це рішення, то зараз краще його розуміли б.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — Past condition, present result

phrases.phrase: If she had accepted the offer, she would be working with us now.
phrases.translation: Якби вона прийняла пропозицію, то зараз працювала б із нами.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — Past condition, present result

phrases.phrase: If I were more organized, I wouldn't have missed yesterday's deadline.
phrases.translation: Якби я був більш організованим, то не пропустив би вчорашній дедлайн.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — General condition, past result

phrases.phrase: If she knew the system better, she would have spotted the problem yesterday.
phrases.translation: Якби вона краще знала систему, то вчора помітила б проблему.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — General condition, past result

phrases.phrase: If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have traveled to the conference last month.
phrases.translation: Якби я не боявся літати, то минулого місяця поїхав би на конференцію.
phrases.section: Mixed Conditionals — General condition, past result

topics.title: Conditionals
topics.description: Use conditionals to connect a situation with its result. Start with the four core types, then explore mixed conditionals.
topics.usageNote: The clauses can change order without changing their relationship: If the tests pass, we'll deploy the update / We'll deploy the update if the tests pass. Put a comma after an opening if-clause. These formulas are a starting point; other modal and tense combinations exist.

sections.title: Zero Conditional
sections.use: General truths, repeated results and habits.

sections.title: First Conditional
sections.pattern: If + present simple, will + base verb.
sections.use: A real possibility in the future and its likely result.

sections.title: Second Conditional
sections.pattern: If + past simple, would + base verb.
sections.use: An imagined or unlikely situation in the present or future. The past form here does not necessarily describe past time.

sections.title: Third Conditional
sections.pattern: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.
sections.use: An imagined change to a past situation and its past result.

sections.title: Past condition, present result
sections.pattern: If + past perfect, would + base verb.
sections.use: An imagined past change with a result now.

sections.title: General condition, past result
sections.pattern: If + past simple, would have + past participle.
sections.use: An imagined continuing characteristic or situation that would have changed a past result. The condition is not a new fact that began only today.
